html:
Leonhard Euler was a Swiss mathematician from Basel, among the greatest of all time. He was born in 1707 and studied under Johann Bernoulli.

He spent his working life at the academies of St Petersburg and Berlin and wrote more than any mathematician before or since. He worked across calculus, number theory, mechanics, optics and astronomy, and founded graph theory with the problem of the seven bridges of Königsberg. Much of the notation used today is his: f(x) for a function, e for the base of natural logarithms, i for the square root of minus one.

He went blind in later life and kept working, dictating to helpers. Basel, with the Bernoulli family and Euler, was one of the homes of the new mathematics of the 1700s.
sum: Leonhard Euler was a Swiss mathematician from Basel, among the greatest of all time. He was born in 1707 and studied under Johann Bernoulli.
